rubric_intent: Score this repo on engineering qualities (tests, code, error handling).

dimensions.name: Test Coverage Depth
dimensions.description: Measures the extent to which the test suite covers the core API and edge cases, going beyond simple functional tests.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Examine the test files (e.g., in a 'tests/' directory) for the variety of test cases, looking for tests that specifically target edge cases, error conditions, and complex interactions, and check for reported coverage metrics if available.

dimensions.name: Type Safety and Static Analysis
dimensions.description: Assesses the implementation of type safety and the adherence to static analysis tools like mypy for robust code.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Review the source code for type hints and check the project's CI configuration or documentation for evidence of mypy or other static analysis tool integration and successful runs.

dimensions.name: Error Handling Granularity and Context
dimensions.description: Evaluates the comprehensiveness and structure of error handling, specifically how errors are caught, re-raised, and augmented with context.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Inspect the source code for try-except blocks and how exceptions are handled, looking for custom exception types or mechanisms to add contextual information to raised errors.

dimensions.name: Dependency Management Rigor
dimensions.description: Determines the intentionality and minimal nature of external dependencies, indicating a focus on stability and reduced attack surface.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Examine the project's dependency list (e.g., in 'setup.py', 'pyproject.toml', or 'requirements.txt') and verify the claim of 'zero dependencies' or assess the necessity and impact of any listed dependencies.

dimensions.name: Code Readability and Documentation
dimensions.description: Assesses the clarity of the codebase and the presence of comprehensive documentation for public APIs.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Browse the source code for clear variable names, logical structure, and comments, and check for the presence and quality of docstrings on all public functions and classes.

dimensions.name: Production Readiness Claims Verification
dimensions.description: Investigates evidence supporting the claim of being 'production-ready' and 'battle-tested'.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Look for mentions of production usage in the README, issue tracker, or commit history, and assess if the project's maturity and stability seem consistent with production use.
